blocks.zh: 包裝組件適格性驗證 — 一般考量（保護、安全、相容性、性能、萃取研究）
blocks.en: Qualification of Packaging Components - General Considerations (Protection, Safety, Compatibility, Performance, Extraction Studies)

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 瞭解 CCS suitability 驗證的四大面向：Protection、Compatibility、Safety、Performance
blocks.en: Understand the four dimensions of CCS suitability: Protection, Compatibility, Safety and Performance

blocks.zh: 掌握 Table 1 的「concern 矩陣」——給藥途徑風險與包裝交互作用可能性的交叉分類
blocks.en: Master the "concern matrix" of Table 1: the cross-classification of route-of-administration risk against likelihood of packaging-dosage form interaction

blocks.zh: 理解 extraction study 與 toxicological evaluation 的兩步驟安全性評估方法
blocks.en: Understand the two-step safety assessment approach of the extraction study and the toxicological evaluation

blocks.zh: 區分不同劑型對 CCS 的 suitability 要求差異（Table 2 的 Case 分類系統）
blocks.en: Distinguish how the suitability requirements for the CCS differ by dosage form (the Case classification system of Table 2)

blocks.zh: 掌握 QC 要求：physical characteristics、chemical composition 的一致性監控
blocks.en: Master the QC requirements: monitoring the consistency of physical characteristics and chemical composition

blocks.zh: 理解 associated components 和 secondary components 的特殊考量
blocks.en: Understand the special considerations for associated components and secondary components

blocks.zh: III.A. Introduction — Qualification of Packaging Components III.A. 簡介 — 包裝組件確效
blocks.en: III.A. Introduction - Qualification of Packaging Components

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Product-Specific Qualification (產品特定的適格性驗證): 一個被核准用於 A 產品的 CCS 不會自動適用於 B 產品。每個申請案都需要獨立的 CCS suitability 數據。這對 CDMO 意味著：即使同一 vial-stopper 系統已用於多個客戶產品，每個新產品仍需獨立驗證。
blocks.en: Product-Specific Qualification: A CCS approved for product A is not automatically suitable for product B. Each application needs its own CCS suitability data. For a CDMO this means that even if the same vial-stopper system is already used for several clients' products, every new product still needs its own qualification.

blocks.zh: Risk-Based Approach (基於風險的方法): FDA 透過 Table 1 的矩陣建立了一套分級框架。兩個軸向：(1) 給藥途徑的風險等級；(2) 包裝-劑型交互作用的可能性。交叉結果決定了 CCS 資訊的詳細程度要求。
blocks.en: Risk-Based Approach: Through the matrix in Table 1, FDA established a tiered framework with two axes: (1) the risk level of the route of administration; (2) the likelihood of packaging-dosage form interaction. The intersection determines how detailed the CCS information must be.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: Table 1 的概念就像機場安檢的分級制度——國際航班 (highest concern = 注射劑/吸入劑) 的安檢最嚴格；國內航班 (low concern = 口服固體劑型) 安檢較簡便。同時，液體物品 (high interaction = 液體劑型) 比固體物品 (low interaction = 錠劑) 需要更多檢查。注射劑是「帶液體搭國際航班」——安檢等級最高。
blocks.en: The idea behind Table 1 is like tiered airport security. International flights (highest concern = injections/inhalation products) get the strictest screening; domestic flights (low concern = oral solid dosage forms) get simpler screening. Likewise, liquids (high interaction = liquid dosage forms) need more checking than solids (low interaction = tablets). An injectable is like "carrying liquids on an international flight": the highest level of screening.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: CDMO 關鍵啟示：無菌充填 CDMO 的主要產品（injections, injectable suspensions）位於 Table 1 的左上角——Highest concern + High likelihood of interaction。這是 FDA 對 CCS 資訊要求最嚴格的類別，意味著需要最完整的 extraction/toxicological evaluation、最詳細的 material composition disclosure、以及最嚴格的 QC monitoring。
blocks.en: Key takeaway for CDMOs: The main products of a sterile fill-finish CDMO (injections, injectable suspensions) sit in the top-left corner of Table 1: highest concern + high likelihood of interaction. This is the category for which FDA requires the most CCS information, meaning the most complete extraction/toxicological evaluation, the most detailed disclosure of material composition and the strictest QC monitoring.

blocks.zh: 圖表解讀 Table Analysis
blocks.en: Table Analysis

blocks.zh: Table 1 閱讀方式:
blocks.en: How to read Table 1:

blocks.zh: 縱軸 (rows) = 給藥途徑的風險程度：Highest (直接進入循環/呼吸系統) > High (眼部/經皮) > Low (口服/外用)
blocks.en: Vertical axis (rows) = risk level of the route of administration: Highest (direct entry into the circulatory/respiratory system) > High (ophthalmic/transdermal) > Low (oral/topical)

blocks.zh: 橫軸 (columns) = 包裝交互作用可能性：High (液體) > Medium (粉末) > Low (固體)
blocks.en: Horizontal axis (columns) = likelihood of packaging interaction: High (liquids) > Medium (powders) > Low (solids)

blocks.zh: 左上角 = 需要最詳細的 CCS 資訊；右下角 = 相對簡化的資訊即可
blocks.en: Top-left corner = the most detailed CCS information required; bottom-right corner = relatively simplified information is sufficient

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 的商務提案中，CCS qualification 的工作量和成本應與 Table 1 的風險分類掛鉤。為注射劑客戶準備的 CCS 數據包（extraction studies、toxicological evaluation、USP tests、compatibility studies）遠比固體口服劑型複雜。這應反映在報價和時程規劃中。
blocks.en: In a CDMO's commercial proposal, the workload and cost of CCS qualification should be tied to the Table 1 risk classification. The CCS data package for an injectable client (extraction studies, toxicological evaluation, USP tests, compatibility studies) is far more complex than for an oral solid dosage form. This should be reflected in quotations and timeline planning.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼 sterile powders for injection 被歸類為 Medium likelihood 而非 High？復溶後的液體與包裝的接觸時間如何影響這個分類？
blocks.en: Why are sterile powders for injection classified as medium rather than high likelihood of interaction? How does the contact time between the reconstituted liquid and the packaging affect this classification?

blocks.zh: 如果 CDMO 同時生產注射劑和眼用製劑，CCS qualification 的策略可以共用嗎？為什麼？
blocks.en: If a CDMO manufactures both injectables and ophthalmic products, can the CCS qualification strategy be shared? Why or why not?

blocks.zh: III.B. General Considerations — Suitability 適用性總論
blocks.en: III.B. General Considerations - Suitability Overview

blocks.zh: Suitability 四大支柱:
blocks.en: The four pillars of suitability:

blocks.zh: 1. Protection (保護): 抵禦外部因素（光、溫度、氧氣、水氣、微生物）
blocks.en: 1. Protection: Protects against external factors (light, temperature, oxygen, moisture, microorganisms)

blocks.zh: 2. Compatibility (相容性): 包裝與劑型不會發生有害交互作用
blocks.en: 2. Compatibility: The packaging and the dosage form do not undergo harmful interactions

blocks.zh: 3. Safety (安全性): 材料不會釋出有害物質到病人會接觸的程度
blocks.en: 3. Safety: The materials do not release harmful substances to a level to which the patient will be exposed

blocks.zh: 4. Performance (性能): CCS 正確執行其設計功能（如 prefilled syringe 的藥物遞送）
blocks.en: 4. Performance: The CCS performs its designed function correctly (such as drug delivery from a prefilled syringe)

blocks.zh: Shelf Life Stability Studies (架儲穩定性試驗): FDA 明確指出，CCS 適用性的「最終證明」是全架儲期穩定性試驗——不是 accelerated studies，而是 real-time, real-condition 的數據。
blocks.en: Shelf Life Stability Studies: FDA states explicitly that the ultimate proof of CCS suitability is the full shelf life stability study: not accelerated studies, but real-time, real-condition data.

blocks.zh: CCS suitability 的四大支柱就像選擇住家的標準：Protection = 房屋能抵禦風雨（防潮、遮光）；Compatibility = 建材不會與居住者產生不良反應（如甲醛釋放）；Safety = 建材本身無毒（不含石棉）；Performance = 門鎖能鎖、窗戶能開關（功能正常）。穩定性試驗就像在這棟房子實際住上整個「保固期」來驗證一切。
blocks.en: The four pillars of CCS suitability are like the criteria for choosing a home: Protection = the house withstands wind and rain (moisture and light protection); Compatibility = the building materials do not cause adverse reactions in the occupants (such as formaldehyde release); Safety = the building materials are themselves non-toxic (no asbestos); Performance = the door lock locks and the windows open and close (everything functions properly). The stability study is like actually living in the house for the whole "warranty period" to verify all of this.

blocks.zh: Suitability 數據可以由三方產生：applicant、材料供應商、或受委託的第三方實驗室。這給了 CDMO 靈活性——可以使用供應商的 DMF 數據、自行測試、或委託 CRO。但無論數據來源，都必須提供足夠詳細的「tests, methods, acceptance criteria, reference standards, and validation information」。
blocks.en: Suitability data can be generated by three parties: the applicant, the material supplier, or a contracted third-party laboratory. This gives the CDMO flexibility: it can use the supplier's DMF data, test in-house, or commission a CRO. But whatever the source of the data, sufficient detail must be provided on "tests, methods, acceptance criteria, reference standards, and validation information".

blocks.zh: 為什麼 FDA 將 full shelf life stability studies 定位為 CCS suitability 的「ultimate proof」？加速穩定性試驗為何不夠？
blocks.en: Why does FDA position full shelf life stability studies as the "ultimate proof" of CCS suitability? Why are accelerated stability studies not enough?

blocks.zh: III.B.1.a. Protection 保護功能
blocks.en: III.B.1.a. Protection

blocks.zh: Protection 的五大劣化因素:
blocks.en: The five degradation factors addressed by protection:

blocks.zh: 1. Light (光): USP <661> 測試；amber 容器或 opaque 外包裝
blocks.en: 1. Light: USP <661> testing; amber containers or opaque outer packaging

blocks.zh: 2. Solvent loss (溶劑損失): 透過容器壁滲透、密封不良或洩漏
blocks.en: 2. Solvent loss: Through the container wall, a poor seal or leakage

blocks.zh: 3. Reactive gases - O₂ (反應性氣體): 透過壁面滲透或密封間隙
blocks.en: 3. Reactive gases - O₂: Through wall permeation or gaps in the seal

blocks.zh: 4. Water vapor (水蒸氣): 透過壁面或密封——LDPE 阻隔性較差
blocks.en: 4. Water vapor: Through the wall or the seal; LDPE is a poor barrier

blocks.zh: 5. Microbial contamination (微生物污染): 密封完整性維護——對無菌產品最為關鍵
blocks.en: 5. Microbial contamination: Maintenance of seal integrity, the most critical factor for sterile products

blocks.zh: CCS 的保護功能就像太空衣——必須同時防輻射 (光)、防真空 (溶劑損失)、供氧管控 (氣體交換)、防水 (水蒸氣) 和防微生物。但不是每位太空人都面臨相同威脅——有些產品對光不敏感，有些錠劑不怕水氣。關鍵是要先做「脆弱性評估」（laboratory studies），確定你的產品怕什麼，再針對性設計保護。
blocks.en: The protective function of a CCS is like a space suit: it must simultaneously guard against radiation (light), vacuum (solvent loss), manage oxygen supply (gas exchange), keep out water (water vapor) and keep out microorganisms. But not every astronaut faces the same threats: some products are not light sensitive, and some tablets do not fear moisture. The key is to first carry out a "vulnerability assessment" (laboratory studies) to determine what your product is sensitive to, and then design the protection accordingly.

blocks.zh: 玻璃的陷阱：FDA 特別指出，雖然玻璃本身幾乎不透氣，但玻璃容器的保護效果取決於容器與密封件之間的密合程度。即使用最好的 Type I 玻璃 vial，如果 stopper 密封不良，氧氣和水蒸氣仍會從密封間隙進入。
blocks.en: The glass trap: FDA points out that although glass itself is almost impermeable to gas, the protection provided by a glass container depends on how well the container and closure fit together. Even with the best Type I glass vial, if the stopper seal is poor, oxygen and water vapor can still enter through gaps in the seal.

blocks.zh: 光保護的實務問題：FDA 已注意到二級包裝（如紙盒）被移除後光敏感藥品暴露於光線的問題。建議考慮在一級包裝本身就提供光保護（如 amber vial），而非僅依賴紙盒。
blocks.en: Practical issues in light protection: FDA has noted the problem of light-sensitive drugs being exposed to light once the secondary packaging (such as the carton) is removed. It recommends considering light protection in the primary packaging itself (such as an amber vial) rather than relying on the carton alone.

blocks.zh: CDMO 在為光敏感的注射劑選擇包裝時，應考慮雙重光保護策略：primary container (amber Type I glass vial) + secondary packaging (opaque carton with overwrap)。同時，對使用 plastic container (如 cyclic olefin polymer) 的產品，須特別評估 WVTR (水蒸氣透過率) 和 OTR (氧氣透過率)，並在穩定性試驗中監控這些因素的實際影響。
blocks.en: When selecting packaging for a light-sensitive injectable, a CDMO should consider a dual light-protection strategy: primary container (amber Type I glass vial) + secondary packaging (opaque carton with overwrap). For products in plastic containers (such as cyclic olefin polymer), the WVTR (water vapor transmission rate) and OTR (oxygen transmission rate) must be evaluated with particular care, and their actual impact monitored in stability studies.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 LDPE 瓶不適合用於含高揮發性溶劑的注射劑？從 polymer 結構的角度解釋。
blocks.en: Why are LDPE bottles unsuitable for injectables containing highly volatile solvents? Explain from the standpoint of polymer structure.

blocks.zh: 無菌注射劑的 container integrity testing (CIT) 為何是 protection 的最後一道防線？PIC/S Annex 1 2022 對此有什麼新要求？
blocks.en: Why is container closure integrity testing (CCIT) the last line of defense for protection in sterile injectables? What new requirements does PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) introduce on this?

blocks.zh: III.B.1.b. Compatibility 相容性
blocks.en: III.B.1.b. Compatibility

blocks.zh: Absorption (吸收): 藥物分子被包裝材料「吸入」材料內部（如蛋白質被 stopper 吸收）
blocks.en: Absorption: Drug molecules are "taken up" into the packaging material (for example, a protein absorbed by a stopper)

blocks.zh: Adsorption (吸附): 藥物分子黏附在包裝材料表面（如胰島素吸附在 glass surface）
blocks.en: Adsorption: Drug molecules adhere to the surface of the packaging material (for example, insulin adsorbed onto a glass surface)

blocks.zh: Leachable-induced degradation: 從包裝材料浸出的化學物質引發藥物降解（如金屬離子催化氧化反應）
blocks.en: Leachable-induced degradation: Chemicals leaching from the packaging material trigger degradation of the drug (for example, metal ions catalyzing oxidation reactions)

blocks.zh: Absorption 和 adsorption 的區別就像海綿和磁鐵：海綿把水吸入內部（absorption），磁鐵把鐵粉吸在表面（adsorption）。兩者都會導致藥物活性成分的濃度降低。而 leachable-induced degradation 就像生鏽的水管污染了自來水——水管本身的問題導致水質變差。
blocks.en: The difference between absorption and adsorption is like that between a sponge and a magnet: a sponge takes water into its interior (absorption), while a magnet holds iron filings on its surface (adsorption). Both reduce the concentration of the active ingredient. Leachable-induced degradation is like a rusty water pipe contaminating the tap water: the problem lies in the pipe itself, and it degrades the water quality.

blocks.zh: 穩定性試驗的「哨兵」角色：某些相容性問題在初始 qualification 時不會顯現，只有在長期穩定性試驗中才會被發現。FDA 要求對穩定性試驗中觀察到的任何可能與包裝交互作用有關的變化都必須調查——無論是 initial submission 還是 postapproval stability。
blocks.en: The stability study as a "sentinel": Some compatibility problems do not show up at initial qualification and are only discovered in long-term stability studies. FDA requires that any change observed in a stability study that may be related to a packaging interaction be investigated, whether in the initial submission or in postapproval stability.

blocks.zh: 這是一個雙向問題：不僅劑型品質會改變（效價下降、pH 改變、沉澱），包裝組件本身也可能改變（脆化、變色）。
blocks.en: This is a two-way problem: not only can the quality of the dosage form change (loss of potency, pH shift, precipitation), but the packaging component itself can also change (embrittlement, discoloration).

blocks.zh: 蛋白質藥物（mAbs）的 CDMO 尤其要注意 adsorption 問題——蛋白質會吸附在玻璃和 polymer 表面，導致可回收率 (recovery) 降低。解決方案包括：siliconized vials/syringes、使用含界面活性劑的配方 (如 polysorbate 80)、或選擇低吸附材料 (如 COC/COP containers)。每次新產品上線前都應進行 container-compatibility study。
blocks.en: CDMOs handling protein drugs (mAbs) should pay particular attention to adsorption: proteins adsorb onto glass and polymer surfaces, reducing recovery. Solutions include siliconized vials/syringes, formulations containing surfactants (such as polysorbate 80), or low-adsorption materials (such as COC/COP containers). A container compatibility study should be performed before each new product goes live.

blocks.zh: 如果穩定性試驗中發現注射劑的 pH 在 12 個月後下降了 0.3 單位，您會如何調查這是否與包裝材料有關？
blocks.en: If a stability study shows that the pH of an injectable has dropped by 0.3 units after 12 months, how would you investigate whether this is related to the packaging material?

blocks.zh: Polysorbate 80 在蛋白質配方中可防止蛋白質吸附，但它本身可能與 stopper 中的抗氧化劑反應。這個矛盾如何在 CCS 設計中平衡？
blocks.en: Polysorbate 80 can prevent protein adsorption in protein formulations, but it may itself react with antioxidants in the stopper. How is this conflict balanced in CCS design?

blocks.zh: III.B.1.c. Safety 安全性
blocks.en: III.B.1.c. Safety

blocks.zh: Two-Part Safety Evaluation (兩步驟安全性評估):
blocks.en: Two-Part Safety Evaluation:

blocks.zh: Step 1: Extraction Study → 找出哪些化學物種可能遷移到劑型中（及其濃度）
blocks.en: Step 1: Extraction Study → identify which chemical species may migrate into the dosage form (and at what concentrations)

blocks.zh: Step 2: Toxicological Evaluation → 評估這些 extractables 經指定給藥途徑的安全暴露量
blocks.en: Step 2: Toxicological Evaluation → assess the safe exposure level of these extractables via the specified route of administration

blocks.zh: 此方法適用於高風險產品：injections、inhalation、ophthalmic、transdermal。
blocks.en: This approach applies to high-risk products: injections, inhalation, ophthalmic and transdermal.

blocks.zh: Safety Evidence 的三級架構:
blocks.en: The three-level structure of safety evidence:

blocks.zh: Level 1 (最嚴格): Extraction study + Toxicological evaluation (注射劑、吸入劑等)
blocks.en: Level 1 (most stringent): Extraction study + toxicological evaluation (injections, inhalation products, etc.)

blocks.zh: Level 2 (中等): USP Biological Reactivity Tests + USP Elastomeric Closures tests (注射劑/眼用)
blocks.en: Level 2 (intermediate): USP Biological Reactivity Tests + USP Elastomeric Closures tests (injections/ophthalmic)

blocks.zh: Level 3 (最簡化): Reference to indirect food additive regulations, 21 CFR 174-186 (固體口服)
blocks.en: Level 3 (simplest): Reference to indirect food additive regulations, 21 CFR 174-186 (oral solids)

blocks.zh: 安全性評估就像食品安全檢驗的分級：直接入血的注射劑（如靜脈注射）相當於「生食」——每一種可能的污染物都要測到最低極限；口服固體劑型相當於「熟食」——經過消化道的 first-pass effect，容許較寬的安全範圍。食品包裝法規 (21 CFR 174-186) 原本是給「食品容器」的標準，FDA 允許用在口服藥的包裝——因為兩者的暴露途徑和風險相似。
blocks.en: Safety assessment is like tiered food safety testing: an injectable that goes straight into the blood (such as an intravenous injection) is like "raw food", where every possible contaminant must be tested down to the lowest limit; an oral solid is like "cooked food", where the first-pass effect of the digestive tract allows a wider safety margin. The food packaging regulations (21 CFR 174-186) were originally standards for "food containers"; FDA allows them to be used for oral drug packaging because the routes of exposure and the risks are similar.

blocks.zh: CFSAN 方法的跨領域借用：FDA 明確表示，包裝安全性評估借用了食品安全 (CFSAN) 的 indirect food additive 評估方法。但要注意：food additive 法規「不直接適用於」藥品包裝——FDA 只是接受它作為某些情況下的「sufficient evidence」。
blocks.en: Cross-disciplinary borrowing from the CFSAN approach: FDA states explicitly that the safety assessment of packaging borrows the indirect food additive evaluation approach of food safety (CFSAN). But note that the food additive regulations "do not directly apply" to drug packaging: FDA merely accepts them as "sufficient evidence" in certain situations.

blocks.zh: 長期使用液體口服劑型的警告：FDA 特別警告，對於慢性用藥的液體口服劑型，僅引用 food additive 法規可能不夠。因為長期使用意味著更高的累積暴露量，超出食品接觸的假設範圍。
blocks.en: Warning for long-term use liquid oral dosage forms: FDA specifically warns that for liquid oral dosage forms used chronically, citing the food additive regulations alone may not be enough, because long-term use means a higher cumulative exposure, beyond the assumptions of food contact.

blocks.zh: 臨床試驗的佐證價值：藥品在臨床試驗中使用特定包裝而無 adverse reactions 是安全性的「supporting evidence」——不是充分證據，但是有力的佐證。
blocks.en: Supporting value of clinical trials: That a drug was used in a specific package in clinical trials without adverse reactions is "supporting evidence" of safety: not sufficient evidence, but strong corroboration.

blocks.zh: CDMO 在規劃 CCS qualification 預算時，注射劑的安全性評估是最大的成本項目。建議的策略：(1) 優先與已有完善 Type III DMF 的包裝材料供應商合作，利用其既有 extraction/toxicological data；(2) 對 elastomeric stoppers，確保供應商 DMF 包含 USP <381> 和 <87>/<88> 數據；(3) 對非標準配方（含共溶劑或 surfactant 的產品），準備進行 drug product-specific extraction study，因為通用的水萃取數據可能不足。
blocks.en: When budgeting for CCS qualification, a CDMO will find that the safety assessment of injectables is the biggest cost item. Recommended strategy: (1) give priority to packaging material suppliers that have a well-established Type III DMF, to leverage their existing extraction/toxicological data; (2) for elastomeric stoppers, make sure the supplier's DMF includes USP <381> and <87>/<88> data; (3) for non-standard formulations (products containing cosolvents or surfactants), be prepared to conduct a drug product-specific extraction study, because generic aqueous extraction data may be insufficient.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 extraction study 的結果不能直接等同於 leachables study 的結果？兩者在 CCS qualification 中各自的角色是什麼？
blocks.en: Why can the results of an extraction study not be equated directly with the results of a leachables study? What role does each play in CCS qualification?

blocks.zh: PQRI 的 Safety Concern Threshold (SCT = 0.15 μg/day) 和 Qualification Threshold (QT = 5 μg/day) 如何與本指引中的 toxicological evaluation 要求銜接？
blocks.en: How do the PQRI Safety Concern Threshold (SCT = 0.15 μg/day) and Qualification Threshold (QT = 5 μg/day) connect with the toxicological evaluation requirements in this guidance?

blocks.zh: III.B.1.d. Performance 性能
blocks.en: III.B.1.d. Performance

blocks.zh: Functionality (功能性): CCS 的附加功能，如計數蓋、雙室瓶、prefilled syringe 的易用性。超越「容納」的基本功能。
blocks.en: Functionality: Additional functions of the CCS, such as a counting cap, a dual-chamber vial or the ease of use of a prefilled syringe. These go beyond the basic function of "containment".

blocks.zh: Drug Delivery (藥物遞送): CCS 準確遞送標示劑量的能力。對 prefilled syringe、MDI、DPI、transdermal patch 至關重要。
blocks.en: Drug Delivery: The ability of the CCS to accurately deliver the labeled dose. Essential for prefilled syringes, MDIs, DPIs and transdermal patches.

blocks.zh: Performance 就像汽車不僅要能裝人（容納功能），還要能安全駕駛到目的地（遞送功能）。Prefilled syringe 就像自動駕駛的車——不僅裝載藥物，還要精確控制注射量和推注力。一個推不動的注射器活塞或遞送不準確的 MDI，就像一台無法啟動的車——功能完全失敗。
blocks.en: Performance is like a car that must not only carry people (the containment function) but also drive safely to the destination (the delivery function). A prefilled syringe is like a self-driving car: it not only holds the drug but must also precisely control the injected volume and the plunger force. A plunger that will not move, or an MDI that delivers inaccurately, is like a car that will not start: a complete functional failure.

blocks.zh: Performance 失敗的五大原因：misuse（使用不當）、faulty design（設計缺陷）、manufacturing defect（製造缺陷）、improper assembly（組裝不當）、wear and tear（磨損）。CDMO 在包裝製程驗證中應針對每個可能的失敗模式設計測試。
blocks.en: The five main causes of performance failure: misuse, faulty design, manufacturing defect, improper assembly and wear and tear. In packaging process validation, a CDMO should design tests for each possible failure mode.

blocks.zh: 對無菌 CDMO 最相關的 performance 測試：prefilled syringe 的 break-loose force、glide force、deliverable volume；vial-stopper 的 coring resistance 和 resealability。
blocks.en: The performance tests most relevant to a sterile CDMO: for prefilled syringes, break-loose force, glide force and deliverable volume; for vial-stopper systems, coring resistance and resealability.

blocks.zh: Prefilled syringe 的 break-loose force 和 glide force 為什麼是 CCS performance 的關鍵參數？過高或過低各會造成什麼臨床風險？
blocks.en: Why are the break-loose force and glide force of a prefilled syringe key parameters of CCS performance? What clinical risks result when they are too high or too low?

blocks.zh: Two-chamber vial 的 performance 測試應包括哪些項目？重組後的藥物遞送準確性如何驗證？
blocks.en: What items should the performance testing of a two-chamber vial include? How is the accuracy of drug delivery after reconstitution verified?

blocks.zh: III.B.1.e. Summary — Table 2: Suitability Considerations III.B.1.e. 摘要 — Table 2：適用性考量
blocks.en: III.B.1.e. Summary - Table 2: Suitability Considerations

blocks.zh: Table 2 是 CCS qualification 的「決策矩陣」：針對每種劑型/給藥途徑，明確指出在四大 suitability 面向（Protection, Compatibility, Safety, Performance）中各需要什麼層級的測試和數據。
blocks.en: Table 2 is the "decision matrix" of CCS qualification: For each dosage form/route of administration, it states clearly what level of testing and data is needed under each of the four suitability dimensions (Protection, Compatibility, Safety, Performance).

blocks.zh: 對無菌 CDMO 的關鍵行：Injections = L,S,M,G + Case 1c + Case 2s + Case 2d。這意味著需要全面的保護測試、液體相容性研究、USP 生物反應性測試 + 可能的 E/T evaluation、以及性能考量。
blocks.en: The key row for a sterile CDMO: Injections = L,S,M,G + Case 1c + Case 2s + Case 2d. This means comprehensive protection testing, liquid compatibility studies, USP biological reactivity tests + a possible E/T evaluation, and performance considerations.

blocks.zh: Safety 等級比較：
blocks.en: Comparison of safety levels:

blocks.zh: Case 1s (Inhalation): 最嚴格——要求 batch-to-batch monitoring of extractables
blocks.en: Case 1s (Inhalation): Most stringent: requires batch-to-batch monitoring of extractables

blocks.zh: Case 2s (Injections/Ophthalmic): 嚴格——USP 測試 + 可能的 extraction/tox evaluation
blocks.en: Case 2s (Injections/Ophthalmic): Stringent: USP tests + possible extraction/tox evaluation

blocks.zh: Case 3s (Oral liquid/Topical): 中等——food additive reference + 非水性溶劑需額外數據
blocks.en: Case 3s (Oral liquid/Topical): Intermediate: food additive reference + additional data for nonaqueous solvents

blocks.zh: Case 4s (Oral solid): 最簡化——food additive reference 即可
blocks.en: Case 4s (Oral solid): Simplest: food additive reference is sufficient

blocks.zh: 注意：Inhalation (Case 1s) 比 Injection (Case 2s) 的安全性要求更嚴格——因為吸入劑直接進入肺部且常為慢性用藥。
blocks.en: Note: The safety requirements for inhalation (Case 1s) are stricter than for injection (Case 2s), because inhalation products go directly into the lungs and are often used chronically.

blocks.zh: 建議 CDMO 將 Table 2 轉化為內部的「CCS Qualification Checklist」，為每個產品類型設定標準的測試清單和數據包要求。例如，注射劑標準清單：Protection (light transmission per USP <661>, CCIT, headspace gas analysis) + Compatibility (USP <661> Physicochemical + stability) + Safety (USP <381>, <87>/<88>, extraction profile) + Performance (syringe functionality / stopper integrity)。
blocks.en: A CDMO is advised to convert Table 2 into an internal "CCS Qualification Checklist", setting a standard test list and data package requirements for each product type. For example, a standard checklist for injectables: Protection (light transmission per USP <661>, CCIT, headspace gas analysis) + Compatibility (USP <661> physicochemical + stability) + Safety (USP <381>, <87>/<88>, extraction profile) + Performance (syringe functionality / stopper integrity).

blocks.zh: 為什麼 sterile powders for injection 的 compatibility 是 Case 2c 而非 Case 1c？復溶這個步驟如何改變了相容性風險？
blocks.en: Why is the compatibility of sterile powders for injection Case 2c rather than Case 1c? How does the reconstitution step change the compatibility risk?

blocks.zh: Table 2 中 Injections 的 performance 是 Case 2d (May be a consideration)。在什麼情況下 performance 會成為重要考量？舉出三個具體例子。
blocks.en: In Table 2, the performance of Injections is Case 2d (may be a consideration). Under what circumstances does performance become an important consideration? Give three specific examples.

blocks.zh: III.B.2. Quality Control of Packaging Components 包裝組件品質管控
blocks.en: III.B.2. Quality Control of Packaging Components

blocks.zh: QC 兩大焦點:
blocks.en: The two focus areas of QC:

blocks.zh: 1. Physical Characteristics (物理特性): 尺寸 (shape, neck finish, wall thickness, tolerances)、重量、性能 (metering valve delivery, plunger movement)
blocks.en: 1. Physical Characteristics: Dimensions (shape, neck finish, wall thickness, tolerances), weight, and performance (metering valve delivery, plunger movement)

blocks.zh: 2. Chemical Composition (化學組成): 材料配方、加工助劑、供應商來源——任何變更都可能影響 safety、compatibility 和 protection
blocks.en: 2. Chemical Composition: Material formulation, processing aids and supplier source: any change may affect safety, compatibility and protection

blocks.zh: QC monitoring 就像汽車零件的「來料品管」——不只看外觀尺寸 (physical)，還要檢驗材質成分 (chemical)。想像買了一批看起來一樣的輪胎，但橡膠配方悄悄改了——外觀沒變，但耐磨性和抓地力可能完全不同。對包裝材料也一樣：stopper 外觀不變，但配方中的硫化劑換了，可能導致新的 extractables 出現。
blocks.en: QC monitoring is like incoming inspection of car parts: you check not only the appearance and dimensions (physical) but also the material composition (chemical). Imagine buying a batch of tires that look identical, but the rubber formulation has been quietly changed: the appearance is unchanged, but the wear resistance and grip may be completely different. The same applies to packaging materials: the stopper looks the same, but if the vulcanizing agent in the formulation has been replaced, new extractables may appear.

blocks.zh: 供應鏈變更的連鎖反應：FDA 描述了一條完整的變更通知鏈：raw material supplier → packaging component manufacturer → drug product manufacturer → regulatory application。每個環節都有通知義務。「Changes which seem innocuous may have unintended consequences」——這句話是 FDA 的核心警告。
blocks.en: The knock-on effect of supply chain changes: FDA describes a complete chain of change notification: raw material supplier → packaging component manufacturer → drug product manufacturer → regulatory application. Every link has a notification obligation. "Changes which seem innocuous may have unintended consequences": this sentence is FDA's core warning.

blocks.zh: Polymer 供應商變更的特殊風險：FDA 明確指出，更換 polymer 或生物來源原料的供應商比更換純化學化合物供應商的風險更高——因為 polymer 和天然材料是「complex mixtures (複雜混合物)」。
blocks.en: The special risk of changing polymer suppliers: FDA states explicitly that changing the supplier of a polymer or a raw material of biological origin carries a higher risk than changing the supplier of a pure chemical compound, because polymers and natural materials are "complex mixtures".

blocks.zh: 安全性常規監控的空白：除了吸入劑產品外，目前沒有通用的包裝安全性常規監控政策。但對注射劑 CDMO 而言，建立 periodic extraction profile comparison 是最佳實踐。
blocks.en: The gap in routine safety monitoring: Apart from inhalation products, there is currently no general policy on routine monitoring of packaging safety. For an injectable CDMO, however, establishing a periodic extraction profile comparison is best practice.

blocks.zh: CDMO 的供應商品質管理 (SQM) 程序應包含：(1) 與包裝材料供應商簽訂 Quality Agreement，明確要求任何配方或製程變更須事先通知；(2) 建立包裝組件的 incoming QC 程序，包含尺寸檢查和至少一項化學組成鑑別測試；(3) 定期（至少年度）驗證供應商的 extraction profile 是否與初始 qualification 數據一致；(4) 建立 approved supplier list 並管控供應商變更的審批流程。
blocks.en: A CDMO's supplier quality management (SQM) program should include: (1) a Quality Agreement with the packaging material supplier that explicitly requires prior notification of any formulation or process change; (2) an incoming QC procedure for packaging components that includes dimensional checks and at least one chemical composition identification test; (3) periodic (at least annual) verification that the supplier's extraction profile is consistent with the initial qualification data; (4) an approved supplier list and a controlled approval process for supplier changes.

blocks.zh: 如果 stopper 供應商更換了 mold release agent 但未通知 CDMO，可能造成什麼後果？CDMO 的 incoming QC 程序能偵測到這個變更嗎？
blocks.en: What could the consequences be if a stopper supplier changes the mold release agent without notifying the CDMO? Would the CDMO's incoming QC procedure be able to detect this change?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 FDA 特別提到 polymer 和 biological origin 材料的供應商變更風險比 pure chemical compounds 高？CDMO 應如何在品質協議中管控這個風險？
blocks.en: Why does FDA specifically mention that changing suppliers of polymers and materials of biological origin carries a higher risk than for pure chemical compounds? How should a CDMO control this risk in the quality agreement?

blocks.zh: III.B.3. Associated Components 附屬組件
blocks.en: III.B.3. Associated Components

blocks.zh: Associated Components (附屬組件): 設計用於遞送劑型給病人，但不在整個架儲期內與劑型接觸。兩種接觸模式：
blocks.en: Associated Components: Designed to deliver the dosage form to the patient but not in contact with the dosage form throughout its shelf life. There are two modes of contact:

blocks.zh: 1. 僅在給藥時接觸（measuring spoon, dosing cup）— 接觸時間極短
blocks.en: 1. Contact only at the time of administration (measuring spoon, dosing cup): very short contact time

blocks.zh: 2. 開封後持續接觸直至用完（hand pump, dropper）— 接觸時間可達數週
blocks.en: 2. Continuous contact after opening until the product is used up (hand pump, dropper): contact time can be several weeks

blocks.zh: Associated components 就像餐廳的免洗筷——不是一直泡在食物裡，但使用時會接觸食物。如果筷子用的竹材含有漂白劑殘留，短暫接觸也可能造成問題。同理，一個 dosing cup 的塑膠材質如果含有高量可萃取物，即使只在給藥時短暫接觸液體藥物，也需要評估安全性。
blocks.en: Associated components are like disposable chopsticks in a restaurant: they are not immersed in the food all the time, but they do touch the food when used. If the bamboo used for the chopsticks contains bleach residues, even brief contact could cause a problem. Likewise, if the plastic of a dosing cup contains a high level of extractables, its safety needs to be assessed even though it touches the liquid drug only briefly at the time of administration.

blocks.zh: Safety 和 functionality 是 associated components suitability 的兩大重點。接觸時間是關鍵考量因素——hand pump/dropper 在開封後持續接觸藥液（可能數週），其 safety 評估標準應比一次性 measuring spoon 更嚴格。
blocks.en: Safety and functionality are the two main focuses of suitability for associated components. Contact time is the key consideration: a hand pump or dropper stays in contact with the liquid drug after opening (possibly for weeks), so its safety assessment should be stricter than for a single-use measuring spoon.

blocks.zh: Prefilled syringe 的 needle shield (針頭保護蓋) 是 primary component 還是 associated component？接觸模式如何？
blocks.en: Is the needle shield of a prefilled syringe a primary component or an associated component? What is its mode of contact?

blocks.zh: III.B.4. Secondary Packaging Components 二級包裝組件
blocks.en: III.B.4. Secondary Packaging Components

blocks.zh: Secondary Components 的雙重角色:
blocks.en: The dual role of secondary components:

blocks.zh: 1. 通常只需簡要描述——不直接接觸劑型，材料安全性concern 較低
blocks.en: 1. Usually only a brief description is needed: they do not contact the dosage form directly, so there is less concern about material safety

blocks.zh: 2. 當提供額外保護功能時（防潮、避光、防微生物）——須提供完整資訊和保護效果數據
blocks.en: 2. When they provide an additional protective function (against moisture, light or microorganisms): complete information and protection performance data must be provided

blocks.zh: Secondary components 就像房子的外牆和屋頂——不直接接觸你的食物（primary = 碗盤），但保護整個居住環境。通常不需要對外牆做食品安全測試，但如果外牆的油漆含有揮發性有機物 (VOCs) 且房子通風不良，這些化學物質可能會進入室內影響健康。同理，secondary packaging 的 ink 或 adhesive 若遷移到透氣的 primary container 中，就變成了安全問題。
blocks.en: Secondary components are like the outer walls and roof of a house: they do not touch your food directly (primary = bowls and plates) but they protect the whole living environment. You normally would not run food safety tests on the outer walls, but if the wall paint contains volatile organic compounds (VOCs) and the house is poorly ventilated, these chemicals could get indoors and affect health. Likewise, if the ink or adhesive of secondary packaging migrates into a permeable primary container, it becomes a safety problem.

blocks.zh: LDPE 容器的交叉污染案例：FDA 特別引用了一個真實案例——LDPE 容器中的液體藥品被 secondary packaging 中的揮發性成分污染。這提醒 CDMO：對使用高滲透性 primary container（如 LDPE、EVA bags）的產品，secondary packaging 的材料安全性不能忽視。
blocks.en: The LDPE container cross-contamination case: FDA specifically cites a real case in which a liquid drug in an LDPE container was contaminated by volatile components from the secondary packaging. This is a reminder to CDMOs: for products in highly permeable primary containers (such as LDPE or EVA bags), the material safety of the secondary packaging cannot be ignored.

blocks.zh: 五大保護功能（moisture, gases, light, handling, microbial）中，若 secondary component 提供了任何一項，就需要提供額外的 qualification 數據。
blocks.en: Of the five protective functions (moisture, gases, light, handling, microbial), if a secondary component provides any one of them, additional qualification data must be provided.

blocks.zh: 無菌 CDMO 在處理 IV bag 產品時要特別注意：flexible bags (通常是 multilayer plastic) 的 overwrap 提供了防溶劑損失和防微生物的保護功能——這個 overwrap 需要完整的 qualification 數據，不能僅用「簡要描述」。同時，overwrap 的 printing ink 和 adhesive 應被評估是否可能通過 bag 壁遷移到藥液中。
blocks.en: A sterile CDMO handling IV bag products must take particular care: the overwrap of a flexible bag (usually multilayer plastic) provides protection against solvent loss and against microorganisms. This overwrap needs complete qualification data and cannot be covered by a "brief description". The printing ink and adhesive of the overwrap should also be assessed for possible migration through the bag wall into the drug solution.

blocks.zh: 注射劑 vial 的紙盒 (carton) 通常只需簡要描述。但如果這個紙盒被標示為「protect from light」，FDA 的期望會有何不同？
blocks.en: The carton for an injectable vial normally needs only a brief description. But if the carton is labeled "protect from light", how do FDA's expectations differ?

blocks.zh: IV bag 的 overwrap 在什麼情況下應被視為 primary packaging component 而非 secondary？
blocks.en: Under what circumstances should the overwrap of an IV bag be regarded as a primary rather than a secondary packaging component?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: CCS suitability 四大支柱：Protection (五大劣化因素)、Compatibility (雙向交互作用)、Safety (extraction + toxicological evaluation)、Performance (functionality + drug delivery)
blocks.en: The four pillars of CCS suitability: Protection (five degradation factors), Compatibility (two-way interaction), Safety (extraction + toxicological evaluation), Performance (functionality + drug delivery)

blocks.zh: Table 1 建立了基於風險的包裝 concern 矩陣——給藥途徑 x 交互作用可能性；注射劑位於最高風險區
blocks.en: Table 1 establishes a risk-based packaging concern matrix: route of administration x likelihood of interaction; injectables sit in the highest-risk zone

blocks.zh: Table 2 的 Case 分類系統為每種劑型提供了具體的 suitability 測試要求指引
blocks.en: The Case classification system of Table 2 gives specific guidance on suitability test requirements for each dosage form

blocks.zh: Safety evaluation 三級架構：Extraction/Tox evaluation (最嚴) → USP Biological Reactivity Tests → Indirect food additive reference (最簡)
blocks.en: Three-level structure of safety evaluation: extraction/tox evaluation (most stringent) → USP Biological Reactivity Tests → indirect food additive reference (simplest)

blocks.zh: QC 雙焦點：Physical characteristics (尺寸、性能) + Chemical composition (配方一致性)；供應鏈變更須完整通知
blocks.en: The two QC focus areas: physical characteristics (dimensions, performance) + chemical composition (formulation consistency); supply chain changes must be fully notified

blocks.zh: Associated components 的 suitability 取決於接觸時間和給藥途徑
blocks.en: The suitability of associated components depends on contact time and route of administration

blocks.zh: Secondary components 通常簡要描述即可，但若提供保護功能或存在遷移風險，則需完整 qualification
blocks.en: Secondary components usually need only a brief description, but if they provide a protective function or carry a migration risk, full qualification is required
